# TwinStudio Evolution DSL example: evolve the front hinge without treating the current form as fixed.
TWINSCRIPT 1.0
NAME "RPi5 hinge evolution"
NAMESPACE "demo"
LABEL domain=mechanical
LABEL product=rpi5-enclosure
ANNOTATION intent="Explore alternatives before committing CAD changes"

PROJECT demo-rpi5 REVISION main
FOCUS "poa://demo/demo-rpi5@main/part/base"
FOCUS "poa://demo/demo-rpi5@main/part/lid"

GOAL VERB improve OBJECT "front hinge" \
  OUTCOME "support-free printing, a clean external joint and opening above 190 degrees"
PRESERVE "wall thickness remains 2 mm"
PRESERVE "Raspberry Pi and connector access remain valid"
AVOID "hinge collision"
AVOID "unsupported overhangs below the configured printability limit"
ASSUME "the existing circular hinge is not the only feasible opening mechanism"
CONSTRAINT "the result must remain manufacturable by the selected FDM route"

METHODS goal_ladder,object_decomposition,bidirectional_graph,feature_lenses,adjacent_possible,brainswarm,assumption_reversal,mutation,recombination,experiment
SEED_VERBS improve,open,fasten,manufacture,inspect
LENSES shape,connectivity_among_parts,spatial_relations_among_parts,force_characteristics,durability_characteristics,human_use,aesthetics
DIMENSIONS manufacturability,assemblability,serviceability,testability,reversibility,cost_value,adjacent_possible
LENS_OPTIONS SOURCE true EXTENSIONS true ASSUMPTIONS true MAX 96
RESOURCE_OPTIONS DESCENDANTS true FEATURES true PARAMETERS true MATERIALS true PROCESSES true ARTIFACTS true REQUIREMENTS true EVIDENCE true HUMAN true ENVIRONMENT true MAX 300
SEARCH UP 1 DOWN 2 SIDEWAYS 1 MAX 48 OPPOSITES true

EVOLVE POPULATION 12 GENERATIONS 4 OFFSPRING 2 MUTATION 0.82 CROSSOVER 0.35 SEED 17 ADJACENT_DEPTH 2
OPERATOR reframe_goal WEIGHT 1.0
OPERATOR repurpose_feature WEIGHT 1.0
OPERATOR parameter_shift WEIGHT 0.8
OPERATOR substitute_process WEIGHT 0.7
OPERATOR modularize WEIGHT 0.7
OPERATOR make_reversible WEIGHT 0.8
OPERATOR add_observability WEIGHT 0.5
OPERATOR adjacent_association WEIGHT 1.0
OPERATOR crossover WEIGHT 0.4

WEIGHT feasibility 0.18
WEIGHT novelty 0.10
WEIGHT manufacturability 0.18
WEIGHT evidence 0.10
WEIGHT risk_control 0.12
WEIGHT reversibility 0.10
WEIGHT sustainability 0.06
WEIGHT cost_value 0.06
WEIGHT user_value 0.04
WEIGHT lifecycle_fit 0.06
SELECT_TOP 5
MIN_SCORE 0.30

LIFECYCLE hardware-product START detailed_design TARGET verification APPROVAL true AUTO_ADVANCE false
ENABLE_STAGE detailed_design,design_review,prototype,engineering_verification,verification
GATE convergence CHECK "at least three materially different mechanisms remain" ROLE creator,admin BLOCKING true
GATE experiment CHECK "each selected mechanism has a physical or slicing experiment" ROLE creator,admin BLOCKING true
GATE verification CHECK "hinge opens above 190 degrees and both parts slice without geometry repair" ROLE creator,admin BLOCKING true

VERIFY "confirm opening angle above 190 degrees in the assembly"
VERIFY "slice both enclosure parts without geometry repair"
VERIFY "print and cycle the hinge prototype"
VERIFY "inspect connector access and external joint quality"

REALIZE change_plan DRY_RUN true APPROVAL true MAX_PLANS 3
ALLOW_OPERATIONS set_parameter,add_feature,suppress_feature,transform_feature,boolean_cut,boolean_add,update_manufacturing,add_test,attach_requirement,add_annotation
OUTPUT GRAPHS json,dot,mermaid REPORTS json,markdown,csv
PERSIST_ARTIFACTS true
INCLUDE_CHANGE_PLANS true
NOTE "Candidates are hypotheses; the graph does not prove mechanical feasibility."
END
